Title: FUN's Cross-Word Puzzle
Copyright: New York World
Date: 1914-04-12
Number: 17
Description: A 12x12 stepped diamond with a Maltese cross over the centre (shown as _); the third row is printed with the letters EASTER in black-letter type, and two clues start from its E and R squares (E-29, R-30). The square at the right end of the seventh row holds a small cross ornament and no letter (shown as #). The corner pairs 1-2 (BA) and 33-34 (RE) have no clues.
Source: Milwaukee Sentinel, 1914-04-12, p. 88
